description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I (Xezat)] and [Spellblade Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I (Xezat)
description.text: Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Spellblade abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Spellblade abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II (Xezat)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II (Xezat)
description.text: Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Spellblade abilities, grants [Quick Cast 3]/[100% Critical (15s)] and [Critical Damage +50% (15s)] to all allies after using Spellblade abilities if 0-2/3+ of Galuf, Dorgann and Kelger are alive

description.name: Critical Damage +50% (15s)
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
